label: SetDateTime
info:
Set Date/Time for both EC100 (Gateway) and Inverter

Inverter Registers (021-026):
- 021: Year (based on 2000, so 25=2025)
- 022: Month (1-12)
- 023: Day (1-31)
- 024: Hour (0-23)
- 025: Minute (0-59)
- 026: Second (0-59)

RPC Method: setDateTime
Params: { dateTimeUtc, timezone, syncInverter, syncGateway }

name: Parse Request
Route Operation
Prep Read 021-023
Build Read Response
Start Sync Process
Prepare Gateway Sync
Gateway Done
Gateway Error
Queue Inverter Writes

Write OK
